What guests mention

What guests mention most

From the photos and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Meze and moussaka

31 Google reviews mention the meze and 24 the moussaka. One guest calls the moussaka sublime, another the biggest they have ever had.

From the grill

8 reviews mention the pork chop and 7 the stifado. Guests write about the best pork chop and lamb chops and about a mixed grill. 2 reviews mention homemade fries.

Large portions and a free cake

13 reviews mention the large portions and 6 a free cake, 3 of them the orange cake. One guest writes that the portions are huge and the prices good.

From the tavern

Photos from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Overlooking the village

One guest describes a cosy little tavern overlooking the town centre of Peyia, reached by steps up to the balcony.

Friendly host

Guests write about a friendly and welcoming host, a relaxed atmosphere and quick service.

Vegetarian too

Guests write about a vegetarian plate and a vegan platter made especially, next to the grilled meat.

What guests say

Three of 325 Google reviews, 270 of them with five stars.

“Second visit this week and definitely not the last. Very authentic Cypriot food, great menu, everything fresh and delicious. Friendly and welcoming host, relaxed atmosphere.”

Google review
“Cozy little tavern overlooking the town center of Peyia. The host is friendly, the prices are good, the food is fantastic, and the portions are huge!”

Google review
